stemMd: A rectangle has perimeter 38 cm and one side 7 cm. What is its area?
explanationMd: If the other side is w, then 2(7 + w) = 38, giving w = 12. Area is 7 × 12 = 84 cm². The perimeter counts both copies of each side.

distractorRationale.c: This uses half the perimeter as the other side without subtracting seven.
distractorRationale.d: This assumes the rectangle is a square.
distractorRationale.e: This subtracts only one side from the full perimeter.
